design_philosophy.description: A clean, airy interface using generous whitespace, soft glass effects, and deep corporate blues to convey authority and modern efficiency.

glass_panel.css_rules: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 20px;
glass_panel.usage: Use for Cards, Sidebar, Modals, Dropdowns

buttons.primary: background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e40af 0%, #1e3a8a 100%); color: white; border: none; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(30, 64, 175, 0.25); transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
buttons.secondary: background: white; color: #1e40af; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 500; transition: all 0.2s;
buttons.danger: background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; border: 1px solid #fca5a5; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 12px;

inputs.default: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; width: 100%; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; font-family: inherit;

admin_dashboard.structure: Grid layout with fixed (but floating visual) sidebar.
admin_dashboard.sidebar: Fixed position, glass effect, distinct from content. Width: 280px.
admin_dashboard.content_area: Generous padding (3rem). Cards should be separated by large gaps (2rem).
admin_dashboard.responsive: Sidebar collapses to bottom sheet or off-canvas on mobile.

public_home.hero: Full height (min-height: 80vh). Text on left, large distinct image on right or background with heavy overlay.
public_home.sections: Alternating backgrounds (White -> Soft Blue -> White). High padding (6rem vertical).

instructions_to_main_agent.css_refactor: Completely overhaul /app/frontend/src/index.css. Replace all hardcoded hex values with CSS variables defined in :root. Implement the 'glass-panel' utility class and apply it to all cards (.card, .form-panel, .sidebar).
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard_update: In AdminDashboardPage.jsx, wrap the main content in a container that provides more padding. Ensure the Sidebar is visually separated.
instructions_to_main_agent.login_page: Update LoginPage.jsx to use a full-screen background with a centered glass card for the form.
instructions_to_main_agent.public_page: Update PublicHomePage.jsx to use the new hero image and increase section spacing.
instructions_to_main_agent.general: Do NOT use Tailwind classes. Write standard CSS in index.css. Use BEM-like naming or standard utility classes as needed. Ensure all text has sufficient contrast.

universal_guidelines: Use 2-3x more whitespace than you think is necessary.
Avoid pure black (#000000). Use #0f172a or similar.
Glass effects must have a border to separate them from the background.
Transitions on all interactive elements (hover, focus, active).
Ensure data-testid attributes are preserved exactly.
